'''''The Chariot''''' was a [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory I-class Star Destroyer]] stationed in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] as the command ship of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was considered an ancient relic from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was only armed with 68 working [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers and a few dozen double turbolaser batteries. These weapons systems and the vessel's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] required frequent service due to their age.
